summary: It is a story telling incorporated with educational charts showing the time line of the legendary spacecraft Sojourner Mars Pathfinder mission 1997 - explaining its each step through a story presentation.
details: Our project revives the legacy of Sojourner: Mars Pathfinder mission (1997)- the first rover on Mars. We created a story telling presentation +enhanced educational charts that traces its full journey. It turns a forgotten spacecraft into a heritage. It is not discarded but it is a seed...
